title: Getting Started with Sky Blue: Startup Account Setup
summary: This document explains how to set up a Sky Blue startup account: eligibility (company within 4 years; funding requirement is 0), the 6 free period, then $25.00 monthly maintenance, and a $0.00 overdraft fee if balance goes negative. It also covers application steps, post-approval configuration (roles, spending controls, alerts), linking external accounts, a referral program ($150 per referral; $250 welcome bonus; 8 referrals/year), and a go-live checklist including an initial deposit and verifying the billing transition.
